author: Thermetrics
versionDescription: Parts Picking > Trips / IHS: trips are now grouped by year (newest first) in both the open list and the Closed Trips accordion. Year comes from the trip's Year of Service, else a year at the start of its name, else the year it was created. Also includes: '+ Add Part' inside each expanded trip, and closed trips in a collapsed 'Closed Trips (N)' accordion.
